csv_scope_of_work: The City of Bondurant will publish a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) for construction manager-at-risk (CMAR) services for new construction of a ~2,500 sf outdoor amphitheater and new construction of a ~1,500 sf restroom structure. Renovations to the existing silo structure to create storage space within. Site work includes a new parking lot. New utility connection for water, sanitary sewer and storm sewer. New site paving and sidewalk along with landscaping features; and other Work indicated in the drawings and specifications.
